description: Minecraft Mod that adds onto the Origins Mod.

releases.notes:
Pretty big update, revamping some origins. This will include the previously missed changelogs.

## Changelog

### Allay
- Added a companion system allowing a pet Allay to follow the player when needed
- Added water vulnerability
- Removed the amethyst-based elytra flight system and replaced it with a music-based creative flight system
- Removed the "Curse You!" debuff
- Removed the 4 heart reduction debuff

### Piglin
- Renamed to "Piglin Chieftain"
- Gave lore to the Origin to make it clearer on why the Piglin can do things that others can't while keeping it up to interpretation
- Added "Hardened Warrior" which decreases taken damage by a little
- Added a power that increases damage for every hired piglin
- Being outside the nether now only halves your regen and reduces damage by 30%
- Changed the hire maximum to 10
- Removed the "Blessed" power
- Piglins no longer target players that haven't hit them
- Optimized a lot of systems in Piglin origins mechanics

### Misc
- Completely removed the "Buildling" origin.
- Added an Auto-Updater that takes the latest updates from Modrinth
- Fixed a crash that was caused by Fog Renderer
- Improved and clarified descriptions for several powers
- Changed the interval for Imp's automatic healing
- Imp has been given one extra heart
- Fixed Radiant's attributes being incorrectly changed
- Fixed Goat's "Sing" power giving regen 4 instead of 3
A lot of changes so I don't think I'm going to bother with the changelog. If you want to see changes I recommend looking at commit descriptions.

Fixing up some things

## Changelog
- Goat's ram power now has a bigger hitbox
- Goat's ram power now takes enemy knockback resistance into account when knocking back
- Horse can actually walk up blocks
- Piglin's enchants on golden gear corrected
- "Heavy" fall damage bonus 50%->33%

A little bit of everything.

## Changelog
### Shrieker
- View distance ?->7 blocks
- Damage bonus 20%->25%
- Echo Location seeing time 1s->5s
- Echo Location cooldown 15s->60s
- Echo Location is now limited to 20 blocks.
- Vision now no longer has the pulsing effect.
- Shader effect changed.
- Food multiplier 1.33x->1.66x
### Misc
- Goat's Ramming now deals knockback.
- Renamed "Turdle"->"Turtle"
- Turtle's turtle master cooldown 30s->60s
- Horse and Turtle now takes 50% more fall damage
- Skeleton now heals 5 hearts instead of 3 hearts when consuming a bone.
- Skeleton has attribute modifiers instead of effects when exposed to the sun.
- Allay's Flying energy loss 0.33/s->0.5/s
- Allay's Flap energy loss 4->6

First low impact origin in the mod, also nerfed allay because playing allay is life on baby mode once you find amethyst.
